description: Before quoting an AI statistic (e.g. '95% of AI pilots fail', 'only 13% of companies are ready for AI'), check where it comes from, who was asked and what it covers. Returns every claim check of a widely repeated statistic and the groups of other figures; fetch the matching claim check, or open the group the figure belongs to. Use it for figures from surveys, reports and the press. For a claim a vendor makes about its own product, use check_vendor_claim.
name: check_ai_figure
title: Check an AI statistic before quoting it
